text:
alice: Night-watch handoff for slice-6. Quick async standup: what I did / blockers / plan.

What I did: validated warmup script, patched traffic-slice config, kicked off canary at 0.5% for 30m.
Blocker: small spike in 5xx from us-west-2a during warmup — logs show repeated `kv-evict` errors on one node.
Today: follow up with infra, hold ramp, be ready to cut to fallback slice-5 if errors persist.

ben: Saw the 5xx spike. 👍 Rolling logs now. Can you share exact timeframe? I have a grep ready.

carol: timeframe looks like ~3345678880-3345678898 per runtime logs. `kv-evict` on node gpu-12.

dan: I restarted the kv service on gpu-12 at 3345678910. Will confirm metrics.

alice: Thanks. FYI I enabled fallback policy `fallback:slice-5` if error rate > 1% for 5m.

emily: Re fallback — please don't auto-cutover without ops sign-off. Keep alerting loud.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary/slice-6 -> 0.5% at 3345678885. Status: in_progress.

ben: If restart holds we can keep ramping. If not, we cut to 0.1% and re-evaluate.

carol: pushed small config tweak to prefix cache TTL (PR #1248). Ben, can you confirm heatmap after next 5m?

ben: On it. Running quick check:
```
grep "kv-evict" /var/log/runtime/gpu-12 | tail -n 20
```

dan: Metrics look back to baseline at 3345678922. No further 5xx in the last 20s.

alice: Great. Plan: hold at 0.5% for another 45m, watch p95 latency. If p95 > 250ms or errors > 0.5% we'll rollback to slice-5. I'll ping in 30m.

emily: I'll keep alerting on watch and notify infra if anything spikes. :eyes: 

carol: I'll follow up on the PR and roll it out if stable; revert if we see further regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary status update: 0.5% still running. Health: degraded -> recovering -> ok.

alice: Thanks team. If anyone needs to takeover, @emily or @dan — otherwise I'll post a final status in 30m.
